answer: A plume of per-task receipts records who did what, and the canyon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
